    From the manufacturer

    The Ultimate in Ray Tracing and AI

    NVIDIA RTX is the most advanced platform for full ray tracing and neural rendering technologies that are revolutionizing the ways we play and create. Over 700 games and applications use RTX to deliver realistic graphics and incredibly fast performance with cutting-edge AI features like DLSS Multi Frame Generation.

    Supreme Speed. Superior Visuals. Powered by AI.

    NVIDIA DLSS is a revolutionary suite of neural rendering technologies that uses AI to boost FPS, reduce latency, and improve image quality. DLSS 4 brings new Multi Frame Generation and enhanced Ray Reconstruction and Super Resolution, powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs and fifth-gen Tensor Cores.

    Game-Changing Realism

    Powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs unlock the game-changing realism of full ray tracing. Experience cinematic quality visuals at unprecedented speed with fourth-gen RT Cores and breakthrough neural rendering technologies accelerated with fifth-gen Tensor Cores.

    NVIDIA Powers the World’s AI. And Yours.

    Upgrade to advanced AI with NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs and accelerate your gaming, creating, productivity, and development. Thanks to built-in AI processors, you get world-leading AI technology powering your Windows PC.

    HYPER FROZR THERMAL DESIGN

    An apex evolution of advanced thermal design that combines fans, core pipes, vapor chamber, and fin shape to unleash unparalleled cooling efficiency and silent performance.

    STORMFORCE FAN

    The STORMFORCE Fan features seven claw-textured blades designed to enhance air pressure, while a circular arc optimizes airflow for superior cooling, minimal noise, and exceptional performance. Built with durable double ball bearings, ensuring long-lasting reliability and smooth operation, even under intense usage.

    ADVANCED VAPOR CHAMBER

    The built-in Vapor Chamber quickly absorbs heat from the GPU and VRAM, efficiently transferring it to the core pipe for optimal heat dissipation

    OPTIMIZED HEAT DISTRIBUTION - CORE PIPES

    Core pipes feature a square-shaped contact area, engineered for maximum heat capture in conjunction with the Vapor Chamber, enhancing overall cooling efficiency.

    FILLED FINS

    Precisely shaped fins fully occupy the thermal module space, sheathing the core pipes to minimize turbulence and backflow, ultimately improving cooling performance and efficiency.

    WAVE CURVED 4.0

    Refined wave edges with a high-low fin design, crafted at precision-engineered angles, enhance airflow from the fan by reducing turbulence and maximizing heat dissipation for superior cooling efficiency.

    AIR ANTEGRADE FIN 2.0

    Expertly crafted with precision angles, heatsink fins featuring a V-shaped cutout and high-low design are strategically positioned at the airflow passthrough to optimize flow efficiency, reduce resistance, and maximize cooling performance.

    ENHANCED DURABILITY AND STABILITY

    The central frame, crafted from solid aluminum alloy, significantly improves the graphics card's durability and structural integrity, ensuring reliable performance and a sturdy build.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
